name: Harmony Touch 7.1, the keys in Play a Game
summary: Every key Play a Game's map holds, tapped, then every long press held.
description: todo-touch.md 7.1, on the bench Harmony Touch holding work/touch-firmware/sets/6.9-label-back (the recorded full sync's documents under tags of ours, 6.8 and 6.9). Every expectation is derived from those documents by packages/bench/src/touchengine.ts, a model of the engine read in the firmware, and named as the monitor names a code of the Touch's own documents. Step 1 presses Off so no activity runs and the engine holds every device off; what it sends depends on what ran before and is not judged. Then Play a Game is started (judged as in the starts test) and every key its map binds is tapped, in groups from the top of the keypad, then every key with a long press is held for about 1 s. Predicted per key: the command the map binds, to the device it names (the volume keys to the activity's volume device); a key with a long press sends nothing when it goes down and its short command when let go inside about 0.55 s, its long command once held past that. A key the map does not bind sends nothing and is not pressed here. A tap held too long sends the long command instead: repeat the step and note it.
